purpose: Independent practice of E1.4 — describing locations with position words.
student_learning_goal: I can describe where something is using position words.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can describe where something is using position words.
header.character_watermark: Trekker Tig in the top-right corner with a treasure map. Small (~1.5in tall). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

parts.student_instructions: Look at each map. Write the position word: above, below, beside, between, in front, or behind.
parts.visual_layout: Four small map pictures stacked vertically. Each shows a treasure in a specific position relative to a landmark.

image_placeholders.description: Four small map pictures for a Grade 1 worksheet, B&W line art. Each ~3in × 1.5in. Map 1: gold token ABOVE a cabin. Map 2: gem BELOW a tree. Map 3: key BESIDE a lake. Map 4: chest BETWEEN two trees. Each panel has a writing line for the position word below.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS04_P1_MAPS at Part 1: instructions ask the child to write the position word for each map. Keywords name the position categories.

parts.answer_key: Map 1: above. Map 2: below. Map 3: beside. Map 4: between.

parts.student_instructions: Read each clue. Draw the treasure in the right place on the map.
parts.visual_layout: A treasure map (~5in × 4in) with cabin, tree, lake, and 4 numbered location clues below.

image_placeholders.description: A treasure map for a Grade 1 worksheet, B&W line art. ~5in × 4in. Features: cabin on the left, maple tree on the right, lake at the bottom-centre, snow-covered hill at top-right. Below the map, 4 numbered clues: '(1) Gold ABOVE the cabin. (2) Gem BESIDE the tree. (3) Key BELOW the lake. (4) Chest BETWEEN the cabin and the tree.'
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS04_P2_MAP at Part 2: instructions ask the child to place treasures on the map. Keywords name the visual elements.

parts.answer_key: (1) Gold drawn above the cabin. (2) Gem drawn beside the tree. (3) Key drawn below the lake. (4) Chest drawn between the cabin and the tree.

parts.student_instructions: Pick 3 things in your bedroom. Describe where each is using position words.

image_placeholders.description: Three sentence-frame lines for a Grade 1 worksheet. Each line reads 'The ___ is ___ the ___.' with three blanks. Generous spacing for handwriting.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS04_P3_FRAMES at Part 3: instructions ask the child to describe bedroom items. Keywords name the prompt focus.

parts.answer_key: Any 3 valid sentences. Common: 'The bed is beside the window.' 'The lamp is above the desk.' 'The toy is in front of the closet.'

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, describe a 4th item using TWO position words.
teacher_notes: Lesson 4 consolidation artifact. Use Part 1 as the formative signal — children who correctly identify all 4 position words have grasped specificity.
